cohort: Low-risk multiparous women with a history of vaginal birth who gave birth at between 37 and 42 gestational weeks
finding: In low-risk multiparous women with a history of vaginal birth, maternal age > 30 years old, parity >1, FAC > 360 mm and < 345 mm, LGA fetus, PROM, and cervical dilatation < 5cm at admission were associated with cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found a higher likelihood of cesarean section in multiparous women with fetal distress, suspected fetal macrosomia, maternal age over 30, parity greater than 1, specific fetal abdominal circumference measurements, large for gestational age fetus, premature rupture of membranes, and cervical dilation less than 5cm on admission.
